content:
Here are the conditions for Canadian Yew seed growth:

• Temperature: 40-50°F
• Hydrometry: 50-60%
• Sunshine: 40-50%
• Rainfall: 30-40"
• Humidity: 60-70%
• Soil pH: 5.5-6.5
• Soil Type: Moist, well-drained

Note: These are approximate ranges and can vary slightly depending on specific microclimate and local conditions.
